title: Keyboard shortcuts and search
bullets: Press ? to see the new keyboard shortcuts. Ctrl or Cmd+K searches every page, game and essay, and can also switch to a dark theme.
Moving between pages now crossfades, and pages you hover over start loading early.
X turns on X-ray mode, which shows the page layout and adds live controls for the front page's ink field.

title: No more flash of my name
bullets: The opening particle animation now plays only if it can start before my name appears, so the name never vanishes once you've seen it.
My name stays the same color when you hover over it or focus it, and keyboard users still get a visible outline.

title: My name stays put
bullets: Moving your cursor or finger over my name no longer blows it apart. The headline stays visible the whole time.
The cursor still stirs the teal current everywhere on the front page, and the opening particle animation is unchanged.

title: Two projects off the public site
bullets: The Miami hurricane replay and the State Foreign Influence Observatory are no longer on the public site.

title: My name in particles
bullets: On your first visit, particles stream in from the edges of the front page and build my name before the headline fades in.
Move your cursor or finger through the name to blow it apart into the current. It drifts back together when you leave.
If you prefer reduced motion, or your device can't run it, you just see the normal headline.

title: The photo becomes an island
bullets: The contour lines on the front page now wrap around my photo like rings around a peak, and the currents flow around it.
The photo has a thin ink frame and a clear margin of paper around it.

title: A living chart on the front page
bullets: The top of the front page is now a slowly moving contour chart, with currents running along its lines.
The lines ring around your cursor or finger, then settle back when you stop.
If you prefer reduced motion you get a still chart, and devices that can't run it keep the plain background.

title: Changelog
bullets: Added this page, which lists what has changed on the site, newest first.
Linked it from the footer.

title: Front page and Aspen fixes
bullets: Removed the welcome cable from the front page.
The Aspen explorer now switches to a backup map when its main 3D service hits its usage limit.

title: State Foreign Influence Observatory
bullets: Added an early version of the State Foreign Influence Observatory.
See where foreign agent laws and bills stand in ten states, the sources behind them, and the plan for what gets built next.

title: Miami hurricane replay
bullets: Added a 3D globe that replays Atlantic hurricane tracks with Miami at the center, using NOAA's historical archive.
Follow each storm's strength, landfalls and closest approach through time.
Uses satellite imagery for a sharper globe.

title: Aspen mountain explorer
bullets: Added a 3D view of the four Aspen Snowmass mountains, with their ski runs and lifts on the real terrain.
Trail symbols and line patterns show difficulty without relying on color.
Works on phones, with sharper terrain on desktop.

title: Connect page
bullets: Added a short page for NFC cards and QR codes, with links to my Instagram, LinkedIn, Substack and this site.

title: Maintenance
bullets: Maintenance and fixes.

title: Private area
bullets: Added a private personal area.

title: New portrait
bullets: Replaced the front page portrait with a closer crop, shown as a circle.
Added a matching image for link previews on social media.

title: 12 Axes
bullets: Added a free political values test that scores you on twelve separate axes.
See the ideologies, thinkers and historical countries closest to your answers, and compare results with a friend.
Your answers stay in your browser.

title: Welcome cable
bullets: Added a welcome to the front page written like an old diplomatic telegram, with redacted lines you can reveal.
Added Costa Rica to the travel list.
Updated the accessibility page to cover the cable and the newer games.

title: History Bowl Study
bullets: Added practice for the National History Bowl: Practice tossups read one word at a time, with a buzzer.
Missed clues become flashcards on a review schedule, and stats track how early you buzz by category, era and region.
Added a four-quarter match simulator against the computer.

title: Borderline
bullets: Added a game with five old political maps and the dates torn off: guess each year from the borders and country names.
New maps every day.

title: Poker
bullets: Added No-Limit Texas Hold'em for two to eight players.
One person starts a room, friends join with the code, and bots can fill the empty seats.

title: Pool
bullets: Added 8-ball and 9-ball on a top-down table.
Play the computer at three levels, or start a room and send a friend the code.
Brought the front page summaries up to date.

title: Flight Path
bullets: Added a geography game: given two cities and the shortest route between them, name every country the plane passes over.
Countries you miss come up more often until you learn them.

title: Off the clock photos
bullets: Turned the fishing photo on Off the clock into a four-photo carousel, with skiing and travel shots.
Added a paragraph on travel.

title: Cambio

One person starts a game and the others join it.

title: Pin drop
bullets: Added a geography game on a globe with no labels: find each place, drop a pin and score points for landing close.
Pick a tier first: Capitals, Second cities or Edge of the map.
